description: This Java class defines the UserContext, which manages user-specific information such as authentication state, roles, privileges, locale, and location within the OpenMRS framework. It includes methods for authentication, privilege checking, role management, and session notifications.

classes.name: UserContext
classes.description: Manages user-specific session information, including authentication, roles, privileges, locale, location, and session events within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user with given credentials and initializes user session data.

methods.name: refreshAuthenticatedUser
methods.description: Refreshes the cached user object from the database.

methods.name: becomeUser
methods.description: Allows a superuser to assume another user's identity.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedUser
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user, or null if none.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if a user is currently authenticated.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and clears session data.

methods.name: addProxyPrivilege
methods.description: Grants a temporary privilege proxy to the current session.

methods.name: removeProxyPrivilege
methods.description: Removes a proxy privilege from the current session.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the user's locale.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the user's locale, defaulting if unset.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all roles for the authenticated user, including anonymous and authenticated roles.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all roles for a specific user.

methods.name: hasPrivilege
methods.description: Checks if the current user (or proxies) has a specific privilege.

methods.name: getAnonymousRole
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns the anonymous role.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedRole
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns the authenticated role.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the user's assigned location ID.

methods.name: setLocationId
methods.description: Sets the user's location ID.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the Location object for the user's location ID.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Assigns a Location object to the user context.

methods.name: setUserLocation
methods.description: Determines and sets the default location for the user upon login.

methods.name: setUserLocale
methods.description: Determines and sets the default locale for the user upon login.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId
methods.description: Retrieves the default Location ID based on user properties.

methods.name: notifyPrivilegeListeners
methods.description: Notifies registered privilege listeners about privilege checks.

methods.name: notifyUserSessionListener
methods.description: Notifies session listeners about login/logout events.
